_meta.ptally/summary: Lists the documents uploaded to a project (policy wordings, product guides and the like), and whether each is ready to search.
_meta.swallow/summary: Lists the documents uploaded to a project (policy wordings, product guides and the like), and whether each is ready to search.

description: List the documents uploaded to a project (policy wordings, product guides, underwriting guidelines or anything else), newest first, with their indexing status. Takes `project_reference` and optional `version_reference` (only documents that apply to that version: those for every version plus any pinned to it; without it, every document on the project). Returns `{ project_reference, version_reference, count, indexed, pending, failed, documents: [{ document_reference, title, filename, status, error, pages, chunk_count, bytes, version_reference, created_at }], next_steps }`. `status` is `indexed` (searchable with search_docs), `pending` or `indexing` (not searchable yet), or `failed` (with the reason in `error`, e.g. a scanned PDF with no text). `chunk_count` is how many searchable passages the document has. Documents are uploaded and deleted in the dashboard, not over MCP. Nothing is changed.

project_reference.description: UUID of the project whose documents to list (get_projects lists projects).

version_reference.description: Optional. Only the documents that apply to this version of the project.

name: list_docs
title: List project documents
